sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your counter-offer; we are pleased to accept the 24-month contract duration to provide stability for both sides.

Extending payment terms to 60 days is difficult for our family-run foundry, so we propose a compromise of 45 days. Our current offer is a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Under these terms, we can offer a revised price of €52.20 per unit. move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to connect with our long-standing partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. As a family-run foundry deeply rooted in our region, we take immense pride in the quality of our craftsmanship and the strong relationships we have built over the years. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. As we have already made significant concessions to reach €52.20 per unit for a 60-day payment term, we must maintain our position. For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We kindly ask you to review our previous offer, which remains our best possible proposal under these terms. We truly value our ongoing cooperation and appreciate your understanding.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We must correct your statement regarding our approval band, as we have never communicated or confirmed such figures. Our position remains unchanged at €52.20 for a 60-day payment term, which reflects the true cost of our high-quality craftsmanship. 

For our complete proposal, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value the deep history between our companies. We kindly ask you to accept this proposal so we can continue our long-standing and trustful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
